tips: Heal behind a wall or inside smoke. Taking damage cancels healing.
The storm does more damage every phase. Start moving to the next circle early.
Crouch inside a bush and anyone more than 15 m away cannot see you.
Supply kiosks sell med kits and ammo. Every elimination earns 50 tokens.
Shotguns and SMGs win inside 12 m. Rifles and snipers win at range.
A supply crate drops inside the next circle at phases 2 and 4. It holds Legendary gear.
Bandages heal in 2 seconds, med kits in 5. Press H to heal.
A Monsoon Barrier stops bullets for 30 seconds. Place one before you heal.
Armour does not reduce storm damage. Stay inside the circle.
Hold aim or crouch to tighten your spread before you fire.
Falls over 8 m hurt. Glide toward lower ground before you land.
The dashed violet circle on the map is the next safe zone.
